name: Canticle
source:
Brother,

I extend to you an invitation to join the Lucent Priory as our newest scribe. The Cantor has selected you from many worthy souls. Here you will work with our skilled arcanists to create the next great Incantation—a powerful tome of magic crafted by many minds together.

You shall study various scholarly fields. Though challenging at first, take heart; other new Brothers will join you, helping each other adjust to priory life.

I enclose 10 silver coins for your journey to Starfall Isle. Please arrive before spring begins.

May the Sisters guide you,

Father Orson

Prior of the Lucent Priory

[From [url=https://voidmammoth.itch.io/canticle]Itch.Io[/url]]
translation:
兄弟，

我向你发出邀请，作为我们最新的抄写员加入朗讯修道院。领唱者从众多有价值的灵魂中选择了你们。在这里，你将与我们熟练的奥术师一起创造下一个伟大的咒语——一本由许多人共同制作的强大的魔法宝典。

你将学习各种学术领域。尽管一开始充满挑战，但要鼓起勇气；其他新修士会加入你们，互相帮助适应修道院的生活。

我随信附上10枚银币，供你前往星落岛之行。请在春天开始之前到达。

愿姐妹们指引你，

奥森神父

朗讯修道院院长

[来自[url=https://voidmammoth.itch.io/canticle]Itch.Io[/url]]
